correctness.rationale: For the round S³ order-five quotient by (z1,z2)↦(ζz1,ζ²z2), t=|z1|² is Haar-uniform and yields two nontrivial deck-distance classes d1(t),d2(t). Any triple of the five orbit centers contains both pair-distance classes, and max(d1,d2)≥2b, b=acos(−1/4)/2. Thus at r≤b, inclusion–exclusion contains only 5 single-ball terms and 10 pair overlaps. I checked the spherical overlap integral I(r,d)=2π[r−d/2−cos²r(tan r−tan(d/2))] and its change of variables against the claim's B_a(r) with a=π/5. Numerical independent high-precision integration at r=0.65,0.75,0.9 agreed with the closed CDF to better than 10^−48; this corroborates but does not replace the geometric all-r≤b argument. Taylor expansion B_a(a+ε)=(4/3)sin²(a) ε³+O(ε⁴) yields the C²-but-not-C³ first cut-locus boundary, without claiming r>b.
